2607.13639.title: OvisOCR2 Technical Report
2607.13639.paper_summary: We introduce OvisOCR2, a 0.8B document parsing model. OvisOCR2 is designed as an end-to-end parser: given a document page image, it generates a Markdown representation in natural reading order, covering text, formulas, tables, and visual regions. We build a data engine that combines filtered real-document annotations with synthetic pages whose rendered images and Markdown targets are derived from the same HTML source. The training recipe includes supervised fine-tuning, reinforcement learning on a 4B branch with a multi-component reward design, on-policy distillation into the 0.8B model, and model fusion. On OmniDocBench v1.6, OvisOCR2 achieves a state-of-the-art overall score of 96.58, placing an end-to-end model at the top of this leaderboard previously dominated by pipeline methods and highlighting the potential of end-to-end document parsing. On PureDocBench, OvisOCR2 also achieves the highest Avg3 score of 75.06. Beyond these two public benchmarks, we evaluate OvisOCR2 on an in-house benchmark designed to cover a broader set of long-tail and challenging scenarios. OvisOCR2 obtains the best overall performance among the compared methods, providing further evidence of its generalization and robustness. OvisOCR2 is available at https://huggingface.co/ATH-MaaS/OvisOCR2.
2607.13639.paper_summary_zh: 我們介紹 OvisOCR2，一個 0.8B 的文檔解析模型。<lb/>OvisOCR2 被設計為一個端到端的解析器：給定一個文檔頁面圖像，它生成一個以自然閱讀順序排列的 Markdown 表示，涵蓋文本、公式、表格和視覺區域。<lb/>我們建立了一個數據引擎，將過濾過的真實文檔註釋與合成頁面結合，這些合成頁面的渲染圖像和 Markdown 目標均源自相同的 HTML。<lb/>訓練配方包括監督式微調、在一個 4B 分支上的增強學習，採用多組件獎勵設計，對 0.8B 模型進行政策蒸餾，以及模型融合。<lb/>在 OmniDocBench v1.6 上，OvisOCR2 實現了 96.58 的最先進整體分數，使得端到端模型位居此排行榜的頂端，這個排行榜之前被管道方法主導，突顯了端到端文檔解析的潛力。<lb/>在 PureDocBench 上，OvisOCR2 也實現了最高的 Avg3 分數 75.06。<lb/>除了這兩個公共基準外，我們還在一個內部基準上評估 OvisOCR2，該基準旨在涵蓋更廣泛的長尾和挑戰性場景。<lb/>OvisOCR2 在比較的方法中獲得了最佳的整體性能，進一步證明了其泛化能力和穩健性。<lb/>OvisOCR2 可在 https://huggingface.co/ATH-MaaS/OvisOCR2 獲得。
